mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.subtitle, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.author_id, a.dept_id, a.campus, a.status, a.visibility, a.priority, a.is_top, a.is_banner, a.is_red_head, a.allow_comment, a.need_receipt, a.publish_time, a.expire_time, a.audit_user_id, a.audit_time, a.audit_remark, a.view_count, a.receipt_count, a.target_count, a.version, a.keywords, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.deleted

c.name as category_name, u.real_name as author_name, d.name as dept_name, (select count(1) from ann_comment cm where cm.announcement_id = a.id and cm.deleted = 0 and cm.status = 'APPROVED') as comment_count
from ann_announcement a left join ann_category c on c.id = a.category_id left join sys_user u on u.id = a.author_id left join sys_dept d on d.id = a.dept_id
mapper.select:
select c.name as name, c.code as code, c.color as color, count(a.id) as value from ann_category c left join ann_announcement a on a.category_id = c.id and a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 'PUBLISHED'
and a.publish_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day)
where c.deleted = 0 group by c.id, c.name, c.code, c.color, c.sort order by c.sort asc, value desc

select date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(a.id) as count, sum(case when a.status = 'PUBLISHED' then 1 else 0 end) as publishCount, ifnull(round( sum((select count(1) from ann_receipt r where r.announcement_id = a.id and r.read_flag = 1)) / nullif(sum((select count(1) from ann_receipt r2 where r2.announcement_id = a.id)), 0) * 100 , 2), 0) as readRate from ann_announcement a where a.deleted = 0
and a.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day)
group by date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date asc

select count(1) from ann_announcement a where a.deleted = 0
and a.status = #{status}

select ,
where a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 'PENDING' order by a.priority desc, a.create_time asc, a.id asc

select ,
where a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 'SCHEDULED' and a.publish_time <= now() order by a.publish_time asc, a.id asc
